note: Owl Carousel integrates the OwlCarousel2 JS slider via two integrations sharing one option set (OwlCarouselGlobal): a field formatter owlcarousel_field_formatter for image fields, and a Views style plugin 'owlcarousel'. Options: items, margin, nav, dots, autoplay(+HoverPause), loop, rtl, itemsMobile/dimensionMobile, itemsDesktop/dimensionDesktop; formatter adds image_style/image_link. No settings page, no configure route, no config schema, no permissions. Requires the third-party owlcarousel2 JS library in /libraries (Drush owlcarousel:download / oc:dl installs it). Medium/hard cases are grounded in the field formatter's real display config (Views style config is fragile on this shared site's Views stack): introspection reads items/margin configured on an image field; execution switches an image field to owlcarousel_field_formatter with a given items count / loop, verified against the live entity_view_display.

evals.prompt: What are the two ways to render content as a carousel with the owlcarousel module, and what are their machine ids?
evals.expected_output: A field formatter for image fields (id owlcarousel_field_formatter, 'OwlCarousel Carousel') chosen on Manage display, and a Views style plugin (id owlcarousel, 'OwlCarousel') chosen as a view's Format.

evals.prompt: owlcarousel says the carousel isn't working because the library is missing. How do I install the OwlCarousel2 library, and is there a Drush command for it?
evals.expected_output: The owlcarousel2 JS library must live at /libraries/owlcarousel2/dist/owl.carousel.js. Run drush owlcarousel:download (alias oc:dl) to fetch and install it (legacy: drush owlcarousel-plugin), or download OwlCarousel2 2.3.4 manually into /libraries/owlcarousel2.

evals.prompt: Which options can I set on an Owl Carousel to control how many slides show, looping, arrows, dots, and autoplay?
evals.expected_output: The shared options include items, margin, nav (arrows), dots (pagination), autoplay + autoplayHoverPause, loop, rtl, and mobile/desktop responsive item counts (itemsMobile/dimensionMobile, itemsDesktop/dimensionDesktop). The field formatter also has image_style and image_link.

evals.prompt: On this site the Article content type has an image field (field_owl_img) displayed as an Owl Carousel. Inspect the live default display and state how many items per slide the carousel is configured to show.
evals.expected_output: field_owl_img uses the owlcarousel_field_formatter with settings.items = 4 (margin 20, loop and nav on) in core.entity_view_display.node.article.default.

evals.prompt: The Article image field field_owl_img is shown as an Owl Carousel. Inspect the live display configuration and state the margin (pixel gap) set between carousel items.

On this site the Article content type has an image field field_owl_pic shown with the plain core image formatter. Using owlcarousel, display it as an Owl Carousel showing 5 items per slide. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: In core.entity_view_display.node.article.default the field_owl_pic component uses type owlcarousel_field_formatter with settings.items = 5.

evals.prompt: The Article content type has an image field field_owl_slide displayed with the plain core image formatter. Using owlcarousel, display it as an Owl Carousel that loops infinitely. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: In core.entity_view_display.node.article.default the field_owl_slide component uses type owlcarousel_field_formatter with settings.loop truthy.
